rules.discovery: First fetch this registry from connected GitHub in each new conversation that mentions the hub, then fetch tool state; never answer only from chat memory.
rules.idempotency: Known video source URL + recorded source SHA256 + existing results means continuation, NOT automatic restart.
rules.no_false_success: Technical test success is not equivalent to reliable video understanding.

tools.purpose: General-purpose video evidence extraction, speech and classroom visual analysis; Artin is one use, not an intrinsic limit.
verified_functions: Download source from tested Uupload link and verify SHA256.
Split any duration to globally numbered five-minute segments with short final segment.
Keep 18-slot batch numbers plus globally unique indexes.
Extract source-linked audio and video frames faster without re-encoding whole video.
Run ASR over all 17 video parts and source-verified merge.
Extract timestamped board and typed-chat cropped images, retain source frames.
Reject duplicate/missing/mismatched parts and block unverified rules.
outstanding: An actual offline evidence reviewer for Android/Windows is delivered with 59 unverified question groups, 35 unverified rule fragments and 192 original source-hash screenshots. It is NOT an autonomous verified teacher rule engine.
Independent measured Persian ASR word error rate against source audio: no verified gold labels.
Original student typed Q&A matched to verified teacher answers: not demonstrated.
Evidence audit of 35 legacy rule candidates: all 35 standalone utterances lack observable market condition, do not promote.
Original private video and transcripts are ephemeral; 30-day V7 artifact retention does not equal permanent video storage.
No complete set of instructor lectures has been provided; the first received session is intentionally only part 1 of an open-ended course. Course synthesis waits for the other user-submitted videos.

course.user_goal: All user-submitted teacher lectures must be sequentially source-grounded and stitched across sessions like a puzzle, preserving later corrections and exceptions; do not require one class to include the entire strategy.
course.source_integrity_rule: Never create a new lecture without user-supplied original video; NEVER infer a correction from unrelated transcript proximity.
